records.source: Supported macOS online installations and dedicated POSIX pip environments use their existing package tool after approved shutdown to stage, verify and atomically activate an updated sibling runtime. records.label: spacr.install_cleanup.start_update_helper#1
records.source: Installer-made copies and supported dedicated POSIX pip environments can use this helper. It waits for the running process to exit before changing the installation; the pip adapter also requires authenticated shutdown approval.
